technical.summary: Strong short-term bullish structure with new highs and confluence, but extreme overbought conditions and lack of fresh crossover signals create elevated pullback risk; suitable for swing entry only with tight stops.

fundamental.summary: PSA shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 84 days present elevated risk.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal; mixed congressional activity from junior member, neutral market fear/greed, and absent news data provide insufficient conviction for directional bias.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (351), CPI event in 1 day creates binary event risk, and real estate sector faces credit stress in tightening environment; earnings in 84 days adds moderate uncertainty.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong short-term technical confluence (RSI extremes, three white soldiers, supertrend bullish, new 20-day highs) with price at 52-week highs provides structural setup for continuation if overbought conditions resolve upward.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 9/14 in exhaustion), stochastic K at 94.51, lack of fresh momentum crossovers, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, CPI event in 1 day, and zero fundamental/sentiment support create unacceptable risk-reward for swing entry despite technical strength.
